case.summary: Petitioner seeks a restraining order against a former partner after repeated unwanted contact and one in-person threat. The parties share no children. Petitioner has moved to a new address.
case.reliefSought: A two-year restraining order with stay-away and no-contact provisions.

timeline.event: Respondent appeared uninvited at petitioner's workplace.
Respondent sent ~20 messages in one night, including 'you can't hide from me'.

evidence.description: Message thread from 2026-04-25 showing volume and the quoted threat.
Filed 2026-05-01, documents the workplace visit and messages.
Coworker who saw the respondent at the workplace on 2026-04-18.
